column3: “Before Asa” is rendered “to meet Asa.” “He will let himself be found by you” is rendered “He will let you find Him.”
“The God of truth” is rendered “the true God.”
“It turned back when it was distress to it” is rendered “in their distress they turned.” “Let himself be found by them” is rendered “let them find Him.”
“Great disturbances were on” is rendered “many disturbances afflicted.”
“Let not your hands drop” is rendered “do not lose courage.”

The Hebrew reads “the prophecy, Oded the prophet”; NASB reads “which Azariah the son of Oded the prophet spoke,” as the ancient versions do. “Detestable things” is rendered “abominable idols,” and “renewed” as “restored.”
“Sojourned” is rendered “resided”; “fallen on him” is rendered “defected to him.”
“Went in the covenant” is rendered “entered into the covenant,” and “being” as “soul.”
“Would not seek” is the NASB rendering of “will not seek.”
“With all their will” is rendered “earnestly,” and “let himself be found by them” as “let them find Him.”
“From queen-mother” is rendered “from the position of queen mother,” and “abominable image” as “horrid image.” NASB supplies “because,” and “to an Asherah” is rendered “as an Asherah.”
“The holy things” is rendered “the dedicated things.”
